purpose: Factual inventory of current project visual files, inline vector markup and visual source references. This document grants no license and does not establish copyright clearance.

discoveryMethod.fileEnumeration: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore with vendored/tool exclusions; ignored art/build and Blender backups included
discoveryMethod.fileDetection: Known raster/vector/3D/font/video/document extensions plus first-256-byte signature scan of every other scoped file
discoveryMethod.excludedMaterial: Git object database, installed Python/Node packages, unrelated tool/system media, temporary files outside the project root
discoveryMethod.visualCodeSelection: Direct drawing, UI markup/text/glyph providers, palette and level-composition data are in visualSourceFiles. Rendering math/layout and direct scene-data producers plus level-authoring scripts are in visualSupportFiles. General input, save, transport, error, audio and solver infrastructure are outside these visual-code counts; named loader/SW relationships remain in runtimeImageReferenceAudit.

runtimeImageReferenceAudit.flow: src/main.js starts AssetStore.load(); manifest-relative image URLs are fetched, decoded through temporary blob URLs, and drawn by renderer helpers. SW validates and caches the manifest image set.
runtimeImageReferenceAudit.blobUrls: Ephemeral object URLs created only from validated manifest image bytes; no separately embedded art payload.
runtimeImageReferenceAudit.serviceWorkerScope: Precache includes explicit application shell and validated runtime art; does not precache art/source, art/previews, art/build, or development gallery pages.
runtimeImageReferenceAudit.serverExposureLimit: Not requested or precached does not mean inaccessible if a server publishes the whole workspace. No final deployment archive is defined or audited here.

findings.detail: Still referenced by PWA/social metadata. Their hashes match the previous register; original authorship/permission remains unconfirmed.
One SVG data favicon and eight inline SVG UI illustrations/icons are now indexed by source line and markup hash; this does not establish their ownership.

All nine UI/gallery screenshots and the sprite contact sheet contain text. These are review composites, not pure art masters. No colorful emoji was observed in these ten captures; other UI states contain emoji.
Every unused export matches a registered current runtime/source file byte-for-byte.
Ignored publication-test image candidates include one corrupt .png and an all-transparent PNG; none is referenced by the real runtime manifest.

limitations: This is a current local-file inventory, not infringement clearance, a license grant or a guarantee of commercial use without risk.

Extension/signature scanning does not exhaust every possible encoded asset hidden in arbitrary code, archives, compressed application formats or future dynamic responses; no such additional candidate was found in the scoped signature pass.

Inline SVG source hashes and visual-code file hashes establish presence, not source originality or ownership. Procedural draw operations and all possible UI/game states are summarized by source file rather than enumerated as infinitely many rendered images.
All ten preview files were viewed, but this inventory does not independently identify their exact rasterized font faces or check every platform emoji design.
Byte-identical duplicate matching is stronger than filename inference; different Blender backup geometry was inspected but not regenerated or proven original.
Only files currently under this project root are included. Prior /tmp screenshots, user machine fonts, browser caches, vendor packages and OpenAI generation storage are outside scope.
Ignored build artifacts can disappear on another checkout. Entries record current local evidence and do not imply these files are version-controlled or deployed.
Regenerated/replaced visuals and changed code require a new inventory and provenance review.

Visual code records distinguish direct providers from supporting scene/math code; they do not certify authorship, exhaustively audit every nonvisual application dependency, or prove the existing generated-level data was reproduced by the currently present generator.
